notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Sarcatog's first ability by exiling two cards from your graveyard.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.
